description: Get the audit trail and cryptographic verification for a document: SHA-256 hashes, chained signature hashes, Ed25519 seals and every event with timestamps and IP addresses.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

document_id.description: The document ID returned by create_draft, list_documents or create_document_from_template.

name: get_audit_trail
title: Get a document's audit trail
